open_work: Four immutable source rows. A closed darkroom entrance gains fitted jambs, threshold and two staggered opaque curtain leaves; no new opening, room or interaction authority.

The former red box and procedural hanging cage are replaced by one native wall lamp under the original electrical actor. Authored actor position, circuit, energy, range, identity and after-hours policy remain; the visible emitter is placed inside the red diffuser.
Radio window stand and backing keep the exact original deck datum and extents supporting the accepted horn and cone. No stock or labels are added.
Photo jamb fronts sit 50mm forward of the former slab and rebate over the actual retained dado; independent floor, dado-face, dado-top and fitted-plaster contacts are checked.
